_comment: PLACEHOLDER seed song ranges (MIDI, C4 = 60) for the offline demo and e2e tests (SPOTIFY_MOCK=1 with the memory store). Every range is approximate, from general knowledge, and must never reach production: real ranges come from USDB note files and the vocal-range pipeline. The first 24 are from the mock Spotify library (one library song, All I Want for Christmas Is You, has no seed, so the skipped-song path stays covered): the high-confidence ones stand in for measured recordings or note files, the low-confidence ones for artist estimates (the Maybe group). Songs marked catalogueOnly are not in the mock library; they give the no-Spotify catalogue mode songs from every decade, plus two more duets. The usdb rows (views, stars, year, genre) and moods are placeholders too; years and genres are the real ones.
